name: quest-language
description: Quest: highlighting, and the Quest language server (docs/lsp.md)

quest.server.path.description: The quest command that serves as the language server (quest lsp): ./quest in a Quest checkout, or an installed quest. Empty: ./quest in the checkout this extension was installed from.

quest.server.includePaths.description: Directories to search for imported units, besides a document's own and the standard library, relative to the workspace.

quest.trace.server.description: Traces the messages between VS Code and the language server.
